children.text: At LPAS, we are powered by curious minds and genuinely kind people. We believe the best ideas happen when hierarchy fades, curiosity leads, and every voice has a seat at the table.

From our open studio in the heart of downtown Sacramento, creativity flows freely, fueled by collaboration, mentorship, and a shared commitment to design that shapes communities. Questions are encouraged. Collaboration is expected. Innovation is part of our identity.
